header_sentences: See After Death, and Other Life.

contexts.text: (Ignorance of the Israelites about the life after death.) SE 2236.
(Modern unbelief in the life after death.) AC 4818:5. AC 4844:end. AC 5006:4. AC 5571. AC 5573:end. LJCont 33.
The delights of the loves of self and of the world take away faith concerning the life after death. AC 7490. AC 8944.
(Source of the belief of the gentiles in the life after death).
This idea concerning the resurrection (of the material body) is attended with this use = that they believe in the life after death... SE 5196.
This commencement of man's life after death lasts no longer than a few days...
They then marvel that they had not believed in such a life after death...
Concerning man's implanted [belief] about his life after death, which is from the influx of Heaven, Explained.
That unless there were a Word, no one would know about... the life after death. General article.

(Ignorance of the life after death a cause of doubt concerning the Divine Providence.) General article. The reason men have not known it, is that with those who do not shun evils as sins there is interiorly a latent belief that man does not live after death... But with all in whom there is any religion the Knowledge is implanted that men live after death, (Ten proofs of this given.)
That man lives as a man after death. General article.
He confessed that he had not believed in the life after death. TCR 80:4.

I said further, that at this day a revelation has been made by the Lord concerning the life of men after death. The Angels said. What [can have been revealed] about the life after death? Who does not know that man lives after death? I replied, They know, and they do not know, Explained.
(Twelve novitiate Spirits deliver their opinions concerning... the life after death.)
All these evils are removed solely by the true use of free determination in spiritual things, which is, to apply the mind to thinking about the life after death.
What pious and wise man does not want to know the lot of his life after death? I will therefore declare the generals in order that he may know. Fully described.
That the life after death is a life to which the life of the body cannot be compared.
Concerning the life after death = that the man appears to himself to be living in the world. Explained. SE 4575. SE 4578.
That the life after death is the life of the internal man. Explained.
